cause_quote: The new retry predicate accepted `details?.eventType === "response.incomplete" && details.incompleteReason === "max_output_tokens"` without checking the stop reason derived from the response status.
user_saw: A Responses session could send an unnecessary continuation request after an unfinished tool call even when the provider explicitly reported that the response had completed, failed, or been cancelled.
summary: The fix preserves the canonical terminal stop reason before tool validation overwrites it and requires a `length` stop for output-limit recovery.
reasoning: The introducing diff added the output-limit predicate as a new reason for the session to retry alongside its existing retry check. That predicate ignored the canonical stop reason, so an unfinished tool call followed by an incomplete event with `max_output_tokens` could trigger the new recovery path despite a conflicting explicit response status from the first version of the feature.
